title: wg: room-policy-04 link capabilities numbered in asset block
description: draft-ietf-mimi-room-policy-04 §8.3 lists canSendLink, canSendLinkPreview, canFollowLink and canCopyLink as message capabilities, but Table 1 numbers them 0x0208-0x020b in the asset block, not the message block (0x01xx). mimid uses the Table 1 values. Editorial, no wire effect. Report to the MIMI WG.
